page_title: NAN 1-2 TOU | Nantes v Toulouse 13/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+9' Willy Delajod interrupts the game. One of the players from Toulouse won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90+6' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Thijs Dallinga and he is replaced by Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse).
90+6' Substitution. Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) replaces Vincent Sierro.
90+5' Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
90+1' 1 - 2 Goal! Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) is quickest to react to the rebound and stabs the ball into the back of the net. It's 1:2.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee points to the corner flag and Toulouse will take a corner.
89' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Mostafa Mohamed walks off the pitch to be replaced by Marquinhos (Nantes).
87' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:4.
83' Here is a change. Zakaria Aboukhlal is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Frank Magri (Toulouse).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Denis Genreau will be replaced by Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse).
82' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
79' The ball goes out of play and Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.

65' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
64' Alban Lafont (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
62' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Denis Genreau plays it into the box, and Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:1.
60' Nantes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Marcus Coco is being substituted because of an injury. Pierre Aristouy sends Jaouen Hadjam (Nantes) on the pitch.
59' Nantes have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
59' The game is interrupted now, Marcus Coco (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
59' Toulouse are bossing possession of the ball and make numerous short passes, but they finally lose possession after an error.
56' A player from Nantes commits a rough challenge. Willy Delajod blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
52' Logan Costa (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
51' Excellent touch by Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box but miskicks and the ball goes well wide of the right post. Poor effort.
50' A spell of possession for Toulouse in an attempt to control the game.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+1' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
40' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' Florent Mollet (Nantes) drives in a shot at goal, but the attempt from the edge of the box flashes just over the bar.
37' The percentage of ball possession is – 41:59.
34' Now Nantes have a corner.

33' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Nantes force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Moussa Diarra (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
29' A corner kick by Toulouse is thwarted by the well prepared Alban Lafont (Nantes).
28' Toulouse take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

28' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a superb stop. The ball goes behind for a corner. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Nantes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
24' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
21' Marcus Coco (Nantes) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that Guillaume Restes expertly pushes away.
19' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
17' Mikkel Desler (Toulouse) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Willy Delajod no option but to blow his whistle.
13' 1 - 0 Goal! Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) puts the ball into the top right corner past the outstretched arm of Guillaume Restes.
12' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

12' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) makes a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul. PENALTY to Nantes! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
11' A lofted cross from Quentin Merlin (Nantes) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nathan Zeze (Nantes).
8' Toulouse are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
6' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
4' It looks like Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) saw red with that tackle. Willy Delajod won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
2' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Nantes will kick-off.
